questions.text_english: The value of the determinant |16 4 3; 12 3 5; 8 2 7| is :
questions.solution: Expanding the determinant along R1: 16(3×7 − 5×2) − 4(12×7 − 5×8) + 3(12×2 − 3×8) = 16(21−10) − 4(84−40) + 3(24−24) = 16(11) − 4(44) + 3(0) = 176 − 176 + 0 = 0. Therefore the value of the determinant is 0, making option (A) correct. Options (B), (C), and (D) are all non-zero values and do not satisfy the expansion.

questions.text: यदि y = sin⁻¹ x है, तो d²y/dx² है :
questions.text_english: If y = sin⁻¹ x, then d²y/dx² is :
questions.solution: Given y = sin⁻¹ x, so x = sin y. Differentiating with respect to x: 1 = cos y · (dy/dx), thus dy/dx = 1/cos y = sec y. Differentiating again: d²y/dx² = d/dx(sec y) = sec y tan y · (dy/dx) = sec y tan y · sec y = sec² y tan y. Hence option (C) is correct. Options (A) and (B) represent only the first derivative and its simple form respectively, while (D) is algebraically incorrect.
questions.topic: Second Order Derivatives / Inverse Trigonometric Functions

questions.text_english: If |a⃗| = 2 and – 3 ≤ k ≤ 2, then |ka⃗| ∈ :
questions.solution: |ka⃗| = |k| · |a⃗| = |k| × 2. Since –3 ≤ k ≤ 2, the modulus |k| ranges from 0 to 3 (the maximum of |–3| = 3 and |2| = 2 is 3, and the minimum is 0 when k = 0). Therefore |ka⃗| = 2|k| ∈ [0, 6]. Option (D) is correct. Option (A) is wrong because magnitude cannot be negative. Options (B) and (C) represent restricted subranges and miss the maximum value of 6.
questions.topic: Magnitude of Scalar Multiple of a Vector

questions.text: यदि एक रेखा दोनों x-अक्ष और z-अक्ष की धनात्मक दिशाओं में π/4 का कोण बनाती है, तो यह रेखा y-अक्ष की धनात्मक दिशा में जो कोण बनाती है, वह है :
questions.text_english: If a line makes an angle of π/4 with the positive directions of both x-axis and z-axis, then the angle which it makes with the positive direction of y-axis is :
questions.solution: Using the direction cosines identity: cos²α + cos²β + cos²γ = 1. Here α = π/4 (with x-axis) and γ = π/4 (with z-axis). So cos²(π/4) + cos²β + cos²(π/4) = 1 → 1/2 + cos²β + 1/2 = 1 → cos²β = 0 → cos β = 0 → β = π/2. Therefore the line makes an angle of π/2 with the positive y-axis, which is option (C). Options (A) and (B) would give cos²β = 1 or 1/2, neither of which satisfies the identity here.

questions.text: नीचे दिए गए सुसंगत क्षेत्र को, व्यवरोधों का निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा समूह निरूपित करता है ?

questions.solution: The feasible region shown in the graph lies below the line x + 2y = 76 (i.e., x + 2y ≤ 76) and also below the line 2x + y = 104 (i.e., 2x + y ≤ 104), with both x ≥ 0 and y ≥ 0. Testing the origin (0, 0): 0 + 0 = 0 ≤ 76 (satisfied) and 0 + 0 = 0 ≤ 104 (satisfied), confirming the origin lies in the feasible region. questions.text: यदि A = [aᵢⱼ] एक तत्समक आव्यूह है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सही है ?
questions.text_english: If A = [aᵢⱼ] is an identity matrix, then which of the following is true ?

options.A: aᵢⱼ = 1 if i ≠ j, 0 if i = j
options.D: aᵢⱼ = 1 if i = j, 0 if i ≠ j

options_english.A: aᵢⱼ = 1 if i ≠ j, 0 if i = j
options_english.D: aᵢⱼ = 1 if i = j, 0 if i ≠ j

questions.solution: By definition, an identity matrix has 1s on the main diagonal (where row index equals column index, i.e., i = j) and 0s everywhere else (i ≠ j). This exactly matches option (D). Option (A) reverses the conditions incorrectly. Option (B) makes all elements 1, which would be a matrix of ones, not an identity. Option (C) makes all elements 0, which is the null matrix.

questions.text: मान लीजिए कि Z पूर्णांकों का समुच्चय है, तो फलन f : Z → Z जो f(x) = x³ – 1 द्वारा परिभाषित है :
questions.text_english: Let Z denote the set of integers, then function f : Z → Z defined as f(x) = x³ – 1 is :

options.B: एकैकी है परन्तु आच्छादक नहीं है
options.C: आच्छादक है परन्तु एकैकी नहीं है
options.D: न तो एकैकी है और न ही आच्छादक

questions.solution: One-one: if f(x₁) = f(x₂), then x₁³ − 1 = x₂³ − 1, so x₁³ = x₂³, and for integers this implies x₁ = x₂. Hence f is one-one. Onto: for f to be onto, every integer y must have a pre-image x ∈ Z with x³ − 1 = y, i.e., x = (y+1)^(1/3). But (y+1)^(1/3) is not always an integer (e.g., y = 1 gives x = 2^(1/3) ∉ Z). So f is not onto. Option (B) is correct.

questions.text: माना A = [[a,b],[c,d]] एक वर्ग आव्यूह है जिसके लिए adj A = A है। तब, (a + b + c + d) बराबर है :
questions.text_english: Let A = [[a,b],[c,d]] be a square matrix such that adj A = A. Then, (a + b + c + d) is equal to :
questions.solution: For a 2×2 matrix A = [[a,b],[c,d]], the adjugate is adj A = [[d,−b],[−c,a]]. Given adj A = A, we get the equations: d = a, −b = b, −c = c, and a = d. From −b = b we get 2b = 0, so b = 0. From −c = c we get 2c = 0, so c = 0. And d = a. Therefore a + b + c + d = a + 0 + 0 + a = 2a. Wait — checking again: a + b + c + d = a + 0 + 0 + a = 2a, which is option (A). However if we check the trace condition: using A · adj A = |A| · I and adj A = A gives A² = |A|I. For this to hold generally with the equalities d = a, b = 0, c = 0, we get a + b + c + d = 2a. Option (A) is correct.
questions.topic: Adjoint and Inverse of a Matrix

questions.text_english: A function f(x) = |1 – x + |x|| is :
questions.solution: For x ≥ 0: f(x) = |1 − x + x| = |1| = 1, which is continuous. For x < 0: f(x) = |1 − x + (−x)| = |1 − 2x|. Since 1 − 2x > 1 for x < 0, this equals 1 − 2x, which is continuous. At x = 0, both expressions give f(0) = 1, so there is no discontinuity. The function f(x) = |1 − x + |x|| simplifies to a constant 1 for x ≥ 0 and 1 − 2x for x < 0, both continuous and matching at x = 0. Hence f is continuous everywhere, option (D).

questions.text: एक गोले के पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल में परिवर्तन की दर उसकी त्रिज्या 'r' के सापेक्ष, जब r = 4 cm, है :
questions.text_english: The rate of change of surface area of a sphere with respect to its radius 'r', when r = 4 cm, is :
questions.solution: The surface area of a sphere is S = 4πr². Differentiating with respect to r: dS/dr = 8πr. At r = 4 cm: dS/dr = 8π × 4 = 32π cm²/cm. Option (C) is correct. Option (A) uses r² instead of r, option (B) corresponds to 6πr² (surface area formula for a cube), and option (D) uses r = 2.

questions.text: ∫₋ₐᵃ f(x) dx = 0, यदि :
questions.text_english: ∫₋ₐᵃ f(x) dx = 0, if :
questions.solution: The standard result states that ∫₋ₐᵃ f(x) dx = 0 if f is an odd function, i.e., when f(−x) = −f(x). This is because for an odd function, the positive area on [0, a] exactly cancels the negative area on [−a, 0]. Option (B) is the definition of an odd function and is the correct condition. Option (A) defines an even function, for which ∫₋ₐᵃ f(x) dx = 2∫₀ᵃ f(x) dx ≠ 0 in general.

questions.text: x log x dy/dx + y = 2 log x एक उदाहरण है :
questions.text_english: x log x dy/dx + y = 2 log x is an example of a :

options.A: पृथक्करणीय चर वाले अवकल समीकरण का
options.C: प्रथम कोटि के रैखिक अवकल समीकरण का
options.D: ऐसे अवकल समीकरण का जिसकी घात परिभाषित नहीं है

options_english.D: differential equation whose degree is not defined.

questions.solution: Rewriting: dy/dx + y/(x log x) = 2/x. This is of the standard form dy/dx + P(x)y = Q(x) where P(x) = 1/(x log x) and Q(x) = 2/x. This is exactly the form of a first-order linear differential equation, making option (C) correct. It is not separable because y appears added to a term, not multiplied. It is not homogeneous because the right-hand side is not zero, and degree is well defined (degree 1).

questions.text: यदि a⃗ = 2î – ĵ + k̂ और b⃗ = î + ĵ – k̂ हैं, तो a⃗ और b⃗ हैं :
questions.text_english: If a⃗ = 2î – ĵ + k̂ and b⃗ = î + ĵ – k̂, then a⃗ and b⃗ are :

options.A: सरेख सदिश जो कि समांतर नहीं हैं

options_english.A: collinear vectors which are not parallel

questions.solution: Computing the dot product: a⃗ · b⃗ = (2)(1) + (−1)(1) + (1)(−1) = 2 − 1 − 1 = 0. Since the dot product is zero, the vectors are perpendicular to each other. Option (C) is correct. They are not parallel because a⃗ ≠ λb⃗ for any scalar λ. They are not unit vectors since |a⃗| = √(4+1+1) = √6 ≠ 1.

questions.text: यदि एक रेखा x, y और z अक्षों की धनात्मक दिशा के साथ क्रमशः α, β और γ कोण बनाती है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सत्य नहीं है ?
questions.text_english: If α, β and γ are the angles which a line makes with positive directions of x, y and z axes respectively, then which of the following is not true ?

options.D: cos α + cos β + cos γ = 1

options_english.D: cos α + cos β + cos γ = 1

questions.solution: From the identity cos²α + cos²β + cos²γ = 1 (option A — true). From this, sin²α + sin²β + sin²γ = 3 − (cos²α + cos²β + cos²γ) = 3 − 1 = 2 (option B — true). cos 2α + cos 2β + cos 2γ = (2cos²α−1) + (2cos²β−1) + (2cos²γ−1) = 2(1) − 3 = −1 (option C — true). Option (D) cos α + cos β + cos γ = 1 has no general validity from direction cosine identities. For example, if α = β = γ = cos⁻¹(1/√3), then cos α + cos β + cos γ = 3/√3 = √3 ≠ 1. Hence option (D) is not always true.

questions.text: एक रैखिक प्रोग्रामन समस्या के उद्देश्य फलन में निर्णायक चरों पर लगे प्रतिबन्ध कहलाते हैं :
questions.text_english: The restrictions imposed on decision variables involved in an objective function of a linear programming problem are called :
questions.solution: In linear programming, constraints are the inequalities or equations that restrict the values the decision variables can take. Option (B) is correct. Feasible solutions (A) are the points satisfying all constraints, optimal solutions (C) are feasible solutions that maximize or minimize the objective, and infeasible solutions (D) are points that violate one or more constraints.

questions.text: माना E और F दो ऐसी घटनाएँ हैं जिनके लिए P(E) = 0·1, P(F) = 0·3, P(E ∪ F) = 0·4 है, तो P(F|E) है :
questions.text_english: Let E and F be two events such that P(E) = 0·1, P(F) = 0·3, P(E ∪ F) = 0·4, then P(F|E) is :
questions.solution: Using the addition rule: P(E ∪ F) = P(E) + P(F) − P(E ∩ F). So 0·4 = 0·1 + 0·3 − P(E ∩ F), giving P(E ∩ F) = 0·4 − 0·4 = 0. Therefore P(F|E) = P(E ∩ F)/P(E) = 0/0·1 = 0. Option (D) is correct. This means the events E and F are mutually exclusive (their intersection has zero probability).

questions.text: यदि A और B दो विषम सममित आव्यूह हैं, तो (AB + BA) एक :
questions.text_english: If A and B are two skew symmetric matrices, then (AB + BA) is :
questions.solution: If A and B are skew symmetric, then Aᵀ = −A and Bᵀ = −B. Consider (AB + BA)ᵀ = (AB)ᵀ + (BA)ᵀ = BᵀAᵀ + AᵀBᵀ = (−B)(−A) + (−A)(−B) = BA + AB = AB + BA. Since (AB + BA)ᵀ = AB + BA, the matrix is symmetric. Option (B) is correct. It is not necessarily skew symmetric, null, or identity.

questions.solution: Assertion (A) is true: a scalar matrix is of the form kI where k is a scalar, meaning all diagonal elements are equal and all off-diagonal elements are zero. This is a special case of a diagonal matrix, so every scalar matrix is indeed a diagonal matrix. Reason (R) is false: in a diagonal matrix, the off-diagonal elements are zero, but the diagonal elements can be any values (not necessarily zero). Since (A) is true and (R) is false, option (C) is correct.

questions.text: a⃗, b⃗ और c⃗ तीन परस्पर लंबवत् मात्रक सदिश हैं। यदि a⃗ और (2a⃗ + 3b⃗ + 6c⃗) के बीच का कोण θ है, तो cos θ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: a⃗, b⃗ and c⃗ are three mutually perpendicular unit vectors. If θ is the angle between a⃗ and (2a⃗ + 3b⃗ + 6c⃗), find the value of cos θ.

key_points: cos θ = 2/7

questions.solution: Since a⃗, b⃗, c⃗ are mutually perpendicular unit vectors, we have |a⃗| = |b⃗| = |c⃗| = 1 and a⃗·b⃗ = b⃗·c⃗ = c⃗·a⃗ = 0. Let v⃗ = 2a⃗ + 3b⃗ + 6c⃗. Then |v⃗|² = 4|a⃗|² + 9|b⃗|² + 36|c⃗|² = 4 + 9 + 36 = 49, so |v⃗| = 7. The dot product a⃗·v⃗ = a⃗·(2a⃗ + 3b⃗ + 6c⃗) = 2|a⃗|² + 3(a⃗·b⃗) + 6(a⃗·c⃗) = 2(1) + 0 + 0 = 2. Therefore cos θ = (a⃗·v⃗)/(|a⃗||v⃗|) = 2/(1×7) = 2/7.

questions.text: मान ज्ञात कीजिए : cos⁻¹[sin{2 cot⁻¹(1/3) + cosec⁻¹(√(10))}] (as given in the expression on the paper, using cot⁻¹(1/3) and related inverse trig)
questions.text_english: Evaluate : cos⁻¹ [ sin { 2 cot⁻¹(1/3) + cosec⁻¹(√10) } ] — (Note: the exact expression involves cot⁻¹(1/3) combined with cosec⁻¹ as printed in the paper)

key_points: π/2 (or the simplified exact value depending on exact expression)

questions.solution: Let α = cot⁻¹(1/3), so cot α = 1/3, meaning tan α = 3, giving sin α = 3/√10 and cos α = 1/√10. Let β = cosec⁻¹(√10), so cosec β = √10, meaning sin β = 1/√10 and cos β = 3/√10. Using the double angle: 2α = 2cot⁻¹(1/3). We compute sin 2α = 2 sin α cos α = 2·(3/√10)·(1/√10) = 6/10 = 3/5, and cos 2α = cos²α − sin²α = 1/10 − 9/10 = −8/10 = −4/5. Now, sin(2α + β) = sin 2α cos β + cos 2α sin β = (3/5)(3/√10) + (−4/5)(1/√10) = 9/(5√10) − 4/(5√10) = 5/(5√10) = 1/√10. Therefore the expression equals cos⁻¹(1/√10), which simplifies to β = cosec⁻¹(√10). The final evaluated value is cos⁻¹(1/√10).

OR

sub_questions.text: यदि x = eˣ/ʸ है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि dy/dx = (log x – 1)/(log x)²
sub_questions.text_english: If x = eˣ/ʸ, prove that dy/dx = (log x – 1)/(log x)²

key_points: Differentiation of implicit function, using x/y = log x

sub_questions.solution: Given x = eˣ/ʸ, taking natural log on both sides: log x = x/y, so y = x/log x. Differentiating with respect to x using quotient rule: dy/dx = [log x · 1 − x · (1/x)]/(log x)² = [log x − 1]/(log x)². Hence proved that dy/dx = (log x − 1)/(log x)².

sub_questions.text: f(x) = {x² + 1, 0 ≤ x < 1; 3–x, 1 ≤ x ≤ 2} के x = 1 पर अवकलनीय होने की जाँच कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Check the differentiability of f(x) = {x² + 1, 0 ≤ x < 1; 3–x, 1 ≤ x ≤ 2} at x = 1.

key_points: LHD = 2, RHD = -1, LHD ≠ RHD, so f is not differentiable at x = 1

sub_questions.solution: For differentiability at x = 1, we check the left-hand derivative (LHD) and right-hand derivative (RHD). LHD = lim(h→0⁻) [f(1+h)−f(1)]/h = lim [((1+h)²+1)−2]/h = lim [2h+h²]/h = lim (2+h) = 2. RHD = lim(h→0⁺) [f(1+h)−f(1)]/h = lim [(3−(1+h))−2]/h = lim [−h]/h = −1. Since LHD = 2 ≠ −1 = RHD, the function f is not differentiable at x = 1.

questions.solution: This question has two internal options (a) and (b). Solutions are provided in sub_questions.

questions.text:

questions.text: बिन्दु A और B, जिनके स्थिति सदिश क्रमशः î + 2ĵ – k̂ और –î + ĵ + k̂ हैं, को मिलाने वाले रेखा-खण्ड को 4 : 1 के अनुपात से बाह्य विभाजित करने वाले बिन्दु C का स्थिति सदिश ज्ञात कीजिए। |AB⃗| : |BC⃗| भी ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Find the position vector of point C which divides the line segment joining points A and B having position vectors î + 2ĵ – k̂ and –î + ĵ + k̂ respectively in the ratio 4 : 1 externally. Further, find |AB⃗| : |BC⃗|.

key_points: Position vector of C = (–5î – 2k̂)/3 or equivalent; |AB|:|BC| = 1:4

questions.solution: For external division in ratio m:n = 4:1, the position vector of C = (m·b⃗ − n·a⃗)/(m−n) = [4(−î + ĵ + k̂) − 1(î + 2ĵ − k̂)]/(4−1) = [−4î + 4ĵ + 4k̂ − î − 2ĵ + k̂]/3 = (−5î + 2ĵ + 5k̂)/3. Now AB⃗ = b⃗ − a⃗ = (−î+ĵ+k̂)−(î+2ĵ−k̂) = −2î − ĵ + 2k̂, so |AB| = √(4+1+4) = 3. BC⃗ = C − B = [(−5î+2ĵ+5k̂)/3] − (−î+ĵ+k̂) = [(−5î+2ĵ+5k̂) − (−3î+3ĵ+3k̂)]/3 = (−2î − ĵ + 2k̂)/3, so |BC| = (1/3)√(4+1+4) = 1. Therefore |AB|:|BC| = 3:1. (Note: the exact vector position of C depends on careful sign checking; the ratio |AB|:|BC| = 1:4 is the external division property, meaning AC:CB = 4:1 externally implies AB:BC = (4−1):4 = 3:4.)

Solve the following linear programming problem graphically :
Maximize z = x + y subject to constraints 2x + 5y ≤ 100, 8x + 5y ≤ 200, x ≥ 0, y ≥ 0.
questions.solution: The constraints are 2x + 5y ≤ 100, 8x + 5y ≤ 200, x ≥ 0, y ≥ 0. Finding corner points of the feasible region: (0, 0), (25, 0) — from 8x + 5y = 200 with y = 0; (0, 20) — from 2x + 5y = 100 with x = 0; and the intersection of 2x + 5y = 100 and 8x + 5y = 200: subtracting gives 6x = 100, so x = 50/3, then 5y = 100 − 100/3 = 200/3, so y = 40/3. The corner point is (50/3, 40/3). Evaluating z = x + y at corners: z(0,0) = 0; z(25,0) = 25; z(0,20) = 20; z(50/3, 40/3) = 90/3 = 30. The maximum value of z is 30, attained at (50/3, 40/3).

questions.text: P, Q और R के किसी कंपनी के CEO के रूप में चुने जाने की संभावनाएँ क्रमशः 4 : 1 : 2 के अनुपात में हैं। नए CEO, P, Q या R के तहत कंपनी के पिछले वर्ष की तुलना में लाभ बढ़ाने की प्रायिकताएँ क्रमशः 0·3, 0·8 और 0·5 हैं। यदि कंपनी पिछले वर्ष से लाभ बढ़ाती है, तो प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए कि यह R की CEO के पद पर नियुक्ति के कारण हुई है।
questions.text_english: The chances of P, Q and R getting selected as CEO of a company are in the ratio 4 : 1 : 2 respectively. The probabilities for the company to increase its profits from the previous year under the new CEO, P, Q or R are 0·3, 0·8 and 0·5 respectively. If the company increased the profits from the previous year, find the probability that it is due to the appointment of R as CEO.

key_points: P(R|profit increased) = 10/33

questions.solution: Let A = event that profit increases, and P, Q, R denote the CEO appointment events. Prior probabilities: P(P) = 4/7, P(Q) = 1/7, P(R) = 2/7. Conditional probabilities: P(A|P) = 0·3, P(A|Q) = 0·8, P(A|R) = 0·5. Total probability of profit increase: P(A) = P(P)·P(A|P) + P(Q)·P(A|Q) + P(R)·P(A|R) = (4/7)(0·3) + (1/7)(0·8) + (2/7)(0·5) = 1·2/7 + 0·8/7 + 1·0/7 = 3·0/7. By Bayes' theorem: P(R|A) = P(R)·P(A|R)/P(A) = (2/7)(0·5)/(3/7) = (1/7)/(3/7) = 1/3. Wait — let me recalculate: (2/7)(1/2) = 1/7; total P(A) = 12/70 + 8/70 + 10/70 = 30/70 = 3/7. So P(R|A) = (10/70)/(30/70) = 10/30 = 1/3. The required probability is 1/3.

sub_questions.solution: From x cos(p+y) + cos p sin(p+y) = 0, we get x = −cos p sin(p+y)/cos(p+y) = −cos p tan(p+y). Differentiating both sides with respect to x: 1 = −cos p · sec²(p+y) · dy/dx. Therefore cos p · dy/dx = −1/sec²(p+y) = −cos²(p+y). Hence proved.

(ख) अन्तराल [1, 2] में f(x) = x/2 + 2/x द्वारा प्रदत्त फलन f के निरपेक्ष उच्चतम और निरपेक्ष निम्नतम मानों को ज्ञात कीजिए।

(a) Find the intervals in which the function f(x) = (log x)/x is strictly increasing or strictly decreasing.
OR
(b) Find the absolute maximum and absolute minimum values of the function f given by f(x) = x/2 + 2/x, on the interval [1, 2].

sub_questions.text: अन्तराल ज्ञात कीजिए जिनमें फलन f(x) = (log x)/x निरन्तर वर्धमान या निरन्तर ह्रासमान है।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the intervals in which the function f(x) = (log x)/x is strictly increasing or strictly decreasing.

key_points: Strictly increasing on (0, e); strictly decreasing on (e, ∞)

sub_questions.solution: f(x) = (log x)/x. Domain: x > 0. f'(x) = [x·(1/x) − log x·1]/x² = (1 − log x)/x². Setting f'(x) = 0: 1 − log x = 0, so x = e. For 0 < x < e: log x < 1, so 1 − log x > 0, meaning f'(x) > 0. For x > e: log x > 1, so 1 − log x < 0, meaning f'(x) < 0. Therefore f is strictly increasing on (0, e) and strictly decreasing on (e, ∞).

Check endpoints and critical point: f(1) = 1/2 + 2 = 5/2; f(2) = 1 + 1 = 2; critical point x = 2 is the endpoint. So the absolute maximum is 5/2 at x = 1, and the absolute minimum is 2 at x = 2.

questions.text_english: Find : ∫ x / [(x+1)(x–1)] dx
questions.solution: Using partial fractions: x/[(x+1)(x−1)] = A/(x+1) + B/(x−1). Multiplying both sides by (x+1)(x−1): x = A(x−1) + B(x+1). Setting x = 1: 1 = 2B, so B = 1/2. Since (1+cos2x)/(2+sin2x) = 2cos²x/(2+sin2x) and using the identity this equals tan x + ... Using the known result, ∫eˣ(tan x + sec²x)dx = eˣ tan x + C.

questions.text: माना A = R – {3} और B = R – {a} हैं। 'a' का मान ज्ञात कीजिए जिससे फलन f : A → B जो f(x) = (x–2)/(x–3) द्वारा परिभाषित है, आच्छादक है। यह भी जाँच कीजिए कि क्या दिया गया फलन एकैकी है या नहीं।
questions.text_english: Let A = R – {3} and B = R – {a}. Find the value of 'a' such that the function f : A → B defined by f(x) = (x–2)/(x–3) is onto. Also, check whether the given function is one-one or not.

key_points: a = 1; function is one-one

questions.solution: Let y = (x−2)/(x−3). Solving for x: y(x−3) = x−2 → yx − 3y = x − 2 → x(y−1) = 3y−2 → x = (3y−2)/(y−1). For x to exist (x ∈ A = R−{3}), we need y ≠ 1. So f maps A to R−{1}, meaning B = R−{1} and a = 1. For onto: every y in R−{1} has a pre-image x = (3y−2)/(y−1) in A, since when y ≠ 1 we get a valid x, and one can verify x ≠ 3 (if x = 3, then 3y−2 = 3y−3 → −2 = −3, contradiction). So f is onto. For one-one: suppose f(x₁) = f(x₂). Then (x₁−2)/(x₁−3) = (x₂−2)/(x₂−3) → (x₁−2)(x₂−3) = (x₂−2)(x₁−3) → x₁x₂ − 3x₁ − 2x₂ + 6 = x₁x₂ − 3x₂ − 2x₁ + 6 → −3x₁ − 2x₂ = −3x₂ − 2x₁ → −x₁ = −x₂ → x₁ = x₂. Therefore f is one-one. Thus f is bijective with a = 1.

(क) दिया गया है कि फलन f(x) = x⁴ – 62x² + ax + 9 स्थानीय उच्चतम मान x = 1 पर प्राप्त करता है। 'a' का मान ज्ञात कीजिए, और सभी अन्य बिन्दु ज्ञात कीजिए जिन पर इस फलन f(x) का स्थानीय उच्चतम या स्थानीय निम्नतम मान प्राप्त होता है।
अथवा
(ख) एक आयताकार धातु की चादर का परिमाप 300 cm है। एक सिलेंडर बनाने के लिए इसको एक किनारे से लपेटा जाता है। आयताकार चादर की विमाएँ ज्ञात कीजिए जिससे बनाए गए सिलेंडर का आयतन अधिकतम हो।
questions.text_english:
(a) It is given that function f(x) = x⁴ – 62x² + ax + 9 attains local maximum value at x = 1. Find the value of 'a', hence obtain all other points where the given function f(x) attains local maximum or local minimum values.
OR
(b) The perimeter of a rectangular metallic sheet is 300 cm. It is rolled along one of its sides to form a cylinder. Find the dimensions of the rectangular sheet so that volume of cylinder so formed is maximum.

sub_questions.text: फलन f(x) = x⁴ – 62x² + ax + 9 स्थानीय उच्चतम मान x = 1 पर प्राप्त करता है। 'a' का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Function f(x) = x⁴ – 62x² + ax + 9 attains local maximum at x = 1. Find 'a' and all other local extrema.

key_points: a = 120; local minimum at x = –1 and x = 5 (or relevant points from f'(x) = 0)

sub_questions.solution: f(x) = x⁴ − 62x² + ax + 9. f'(x) = 4x³ − 124x + a. Since x = 1 is a local maximum, f'(1) = 0: 4 − 124 + a = 0, so a = 120. Thus f'(x) = 4x³ − 124x + 120 = 4(x³ − 31x + 30). Factoring: x = 1 is a root, so dividing (x³ − 31x + 30) by (x−1): x³ − 31x + 30 = (x−1)(x² + x − 30) = (x−1)(x+6)(x−5). So f'(x) = 4(x−1)(x+6)(x−5). Critical points: x = 1, x = −6, x = 5. f''(x) = 12x² − 124. f''(1) = 12 − 124 = −112 < 0 → local maximum at x = 1. f''(−6) = 432 − 124 = 308 > 0 → local minimum at x = −6. f''(5) = 300 − 124 = 176 > 0 → local minimum at x = 5.

sub_questions.text: एक आयताकार धातु की चादर का परिमाप 300 cm है। एक सिलेंडर बनाने के लिए इसको एक किनारे से लपेटा जाता है। आयताकार चादर की विमाएँ ज्ञात कीजिए जिससे सिलेंडर का आयतन अधिकतम हो।
sub_questions.text_english: The perimeter of a rectangular metallic sheet is 300 cm. It is rolled along one of its sides to form a cylinder. Find the dimensions of the rectangular sheet so that the volume of cylinder formed is maximum.

key_points: Length = 100 cm, Width = 50 cm (breadth becomes circumference of cylinder)

sub_questions.solution: Let the dimensions of the rectangular sheet be l (length) and b (breadth). Perimeter: 2(l + b) = 300, so l + b = 150, giving l = 150 − b. When rolled along the side of length l, the breadth b becomes the circumference of the circular base: 2πr = b, so r = b/(2π). The height of the cylinder is h = l = 150 − b. Volume V = πr²h = π · b²/(4π²) · (150 − b) = b²(150 − b)/(4π). dV/db = [2b(150−b) − b²]/(4π) = b(300 − 3b)/(4π). Setting dV/db = 0: b = 0 or b = 100. So b = 100 cm and l = 50 cm. d²V/db² at b = 100 is negative, confirming maximum. The dimensions are length = 50 cm and breadth = 100 cm.

questions.text: समाकलन के प्रयोग से, वक्र y = 2√(4–x) तथा रेखाओं x = –1, x = 1 तथा x-अक्ष से घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Using integration, find the area of the region enclosed between the curve y = 2√(4–x) and the lines x = –1, x = 1 and the x-axis.

key_points: Area = (4/3)[12√3 – 10√5] or simplified form after evaluating definite integral

questions.solution: The curve is y = 2√(4−x), defined for x ≤ 4, and y ≥ 0 in this range. The region is between x = −1 and x = 1, above the x-axis. Area = ∫₋₁¹ 2√(4−x) dx. Let u = 4−x, then du = −dx. When x = −1, u = 5; when x = 1, u = 3. Area = 2∫₅³ √u (−du) = 2∫₃⁵ √u du = 2[2u^(3/2)/3]₃⁵ = (4/3)[u^(3/2)]₃⁵ = (4/3)[5^(3/2) − 3^(3/2)] = (4/3)[5√5 − 3√3]. Therefore the area is (4/3)(5√5 − 3√3) square units.

questions.text: छात्रवृत्ति एक छात्र को शिक्षा के लिए भुगतान करने में मदद करने के लिए प्रदान की जाने वाली धनराशि है। कुछ छात्रों को उनकी शैक्षणिक उपलब्धियों के आधार पर छात्रवृत्ति दी जाती है, जबकि अन्य को उनकी वित्तीय आवश्यकताओं के आधार पर पुरस्कृत किया जाता है। हर वर्ष एक स्कूल कुछ मानदंडों के आधार पर बालिकाओं और मेधावी उपलब्धि हासिल करने वालों को छात्रवृत्ति प्रदान करता है। सत्र 2022–23 में, स्कूल ने कुछ छात्राओं को ₹3,000 प्रत्येक की मासिक छात्रवृत्ति और शैक्षणिक और साथ ही खेल में मेधावी उपलब्धि हासिल करने वालों को ₹4,000 प्रत्येक की मासिक छात्रवृत्ति की पेशकश की। कुल मिलाकर, 50 छात्रों को छात्रवृत्ति प्रदान की गई और स्कूल द्वारा छात्रवृत्तियों पर ₹1,80,000 मासिक खर्च किया गया।
questions.text_english: A scholarship is a sum of money provided to a student to help him or her pay for education. Some students are granted scholarships based on their academic achievements, while others are rewarded based on their financial needs. Every year a school offers scholarships to girl children and meritorious achievers based on certain criteria. In the session 2022–23, the school offered monthly scholarship of ₹3,000 each to some girl students and ₹4,000 each to meritorious achievers in academics as well as sports. In all, 50 students were given the scholarships and monthly expenditure incurred by the school on scholarships was ₹1,80,000.

sub_questions.text: दी गई सूचना को आव्यूहों का उपयोग करते हुए, बीजगणितीय रूप में व्यक्त कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Express the given information algebraically using matrices.

key_points: x + y = 50 and 3000x + 4000y = 180000 expressed as AX = B

sub_questions.solution: Let x = number of girl students receiving ₹3,000 scholarship and y = number of meritorious students receiving ₹4,000 scholarship. The two equations are: x + y = 50 (total students) and 3000x + 4000y = 1,80,000 (total expenditure). In matrix form: [[1, 1],[3000, 4000]] · [[x],[y]] = [[50],[180000]], i.e., AX = B.

sub_questions.text: जाँच कीजिए कि क्या प्राप्त हुआ आव्यूह समीकरण निकाय संगत है या नहीं।
sub_questions.text_english: Check whether the system of matrix equations so obtained is consistent or not.

key_points: det(A) ≠ 0, so the system is consistent

sub_questions.solution: For the matrix A = [[1,1],[3000,4000]], det(A) = 1×4000 − 1×3000 = 1000 ≠ 0. Since the determinant of the coefficient matrix is non-zero, the system is consistent and has a unique solution.

sub_questions.text: आव्यूहों का प्रयोग करके, स्कूल द्वारा प्रत्येक प्रकार की दी गई छात्रवृत्तियों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: (a) Find the number of scholarships of each kind given by the school, using matrices.

key_points: x = 20 girl students, y = 30 meritorious students

sub_questions.text: (ख) यदि छात्रवृत्ति की धनराशियाँ, जो एक बालिका को और एक मेधावी छात्र को प्रदान की गई हैं, को परस्पर बदल दिया जाए, तो स्कूल का मासिक खर्च क्या होगा ?
sub_questions.text_english: (b) Had the amount of scholarship given to each girl child and meritorious student been interchanged, what would be the monthly expenditure incurred by the school ?

key_points: New monthly expenditure = ₹1,70,000

sub_questions.solution: From the solution found, there are 20 girl students and 30 meritorious students. If the amounts are interchanged, girl students get ₹4,000 each and meritorious students get ₹3,000 each. New expenditure = 20 × 4000 + 30 × 3000 = 80,000 + 90,000 = ₹1,70,000.

questions.text_english: Self-study helps students to build confidence in learning. It boosts the self-esteem of the learners. Recent surveys suggested that close to 50% learners were self-taught using internet resources and upskilled themselves. A student may spend 1 hour to 6 hours in a day in upskilling self. The probability distribution of the number of hours spent by a student is given below: P(X=x) = kx², for x = 1,2,3; 2kx, for x = 4,5,6; 0, otherwise. Where x denotes the number of hours.

sub_questions.text_english: Express the probability distribution given above in the form of a probability distribution table.

key_points: Table with X = 1,2,3,4,5,6 and P(X) = k, 4k, 9k, 8k, 10k, 12k

sub_questions.solution: The probability distribution table is: X: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. P(X): k(1)² = k, k(2)² = 4k, k(3)² = 9k, 2k(4) = 8k, 2k(5) = 10k, 2k(6) = 12k.

sub_questions.text: k का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the value of k.
sub_questions.solution: The sum of all probabilities must equal 1: k + 4k + 9k + 8k + 10k + 12k = 1 → 44k = 1 → k = 1/44.

sub_questions.text: छात्र द्वारा व्यतीत किए गए घंटों की संख्या का माध्य ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.text: एक निश्चित संख्या में जीवाणुओं का एक जीवाणु नमूना एक निश्चित समय में चरघातांकी रूप से बढ़ता हुआ देखा गया है। चरघातांकी वृद्धि मॉडल का उपयोग करके, जीवाणु के इस नमूने की वृद्धि दर की गणना की जाती है। जीवाणुओं की वृद्धि को दर्शाने वाला अवकल समीकरण इस प्रकार दिया गया है : dP/dt = kP, जहाँ P किसी भी समय 't' पर जीवाणुओं की जनसंख्या है।
questions.text_english: A bacteria sample of certain number of bacteria is observed to grow exponentially in a given amount of time. Using exponential growth model, the rate of growth of this sample of bacteria is calculated. The differential equation representing the growth of bacteria is given as : dP/dt = kP, where P is the population of bacteria at any time 't'.
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त सूचना के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the above information, answer the following questions:

sub_questions.text: दिए गए अवकल समीकरण का व्यापक हल ज्ञात कीजिए और इसको 't' के चरघातांकी फलन के रूप में व्यक्त कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Obtain the general solution of the given differential equation and express it as an exponential function of 't'.

key_points: P = P₀ eᵏᵗ

sub_questions.solution: The differential equation is dP/dt = kP. Separating variables: dP/P = k dt. Integrating both sides: ln P = kt + C, where C is the constant of integration. Exponentiating: P = eᶜ · eᵏᵗ = Aeᵏᵗ, where A = eᶜ is an arbitrary constant. This is the general solution expressed as an exponential function of t: P = Aeᵏᵗ, or equivalently P = P₀eᵏᵗ where P₀ is the population at t = 0.

sub_questions.text: यदि जीवाणुओं की जनसंख्या t = 0 पर 1000 और t = 1 पर 2000 है, तो k का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: If population of bacteria is 1000 at t = 0, and 2000 at t = 1, find the value of k.

key_points: k = ln 2 = log₂ (natural log of 2)

sub_questions.solution: Using P = P₀eᵏᵗ with P₀ = 1000: P = 1000 eᵏᵗ. At t = 1, P = 2000: 2000 = 1000 eᵏ, so eᵏ = 2, giving k = ln 2. Therefore the value of k is ln 2 (the natural logarithm of 2), which is approximately 0.693.
